beats.text: Half of Niger is younger than 15 while half of Japan is older than 49.
Median age is the age that divides the population into two halves of equal size: half of the people are older than it and half are younger.
Central African Rep. is the lowest of all 219 with a median age of 14.
Japan is 49, one of the highest on Earth.
Japan has 3.5 times Central African Rep.'s value.
India sits at 28 and USA at 38.
